subunit: Homodimer; disulfide-linked. Also found as heterodimer with PGF. Interacts with NRP1. Interacts with isoform 2 of BSG. Interacts with CD82; this interaction inhibits VEGFA-mediated signaling pathway

chains.name: Vascular endothelial growth factor A, long form

complexes.name: Vascular endothelial growth factor A complex
complexes.function: Growth factor active in angiogenesis, vasculogenesis and endothelial cell growth. Induces endothelial cell proliferation, promotes cell migration, inhibits apoptosis and induces permeabilization of blood vessels. Can promote tumor vascularization. Ligand to vascular endothelial growth factor receptor (VGFR-1) complex. Has heparin-binding properties.
complexes.properties: Homodimer, with the antiparallel monomers linked by two inter-chain disulphide bonds.
